comment: A wmill sync pull tree (Gen 2: native trigger, schedule, HTTP route, e-mail trigger). The test zips these files.

files.wmill.yaml:
includes:
  - f/**
includeSchedules: true
includeTriggers: true
files.f/ops/invoice_intake__flow/flow.yaml:
summary: Invoice intake
description: A PDF lands in the Invoices folder; read it and tell the team.
schema:
  $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
  type: object
  properties:
    time: { type: integer }
    user:
      type: object
      properties: { uid: { type: string }, displayName: { type: string } }
    event:
      type: object
      properties:
        class: { type: string }
        node:
          type: object
          properties: { id: { type: integer }, path: { type: string } }
    authentication:
      type: object
      properties:
        owner: { type: object, format: resource-nextcloud }
        trigger: { type: object, format: resource-nextcloud }
value:
  modules:
    - id: name
      summary: File name
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline file_name.ts'
        input_transforms:
          path: { type: javascript, expr: flow_input.event.node.path }
    - id: read
      summary: Get file content
      retry: { constant: { attempts: 3, seconds: 10 } }
      value:
        type: script
        path: hub/28150/nextcloud/nextcloud_webdav:_get_file_content
        input_transforms:
          nextcloud: { type: javascript, expr: flow_input.authentication.owner }
          path: { type: javascript, expr: flow_input.event.node.path }
    - id: post
      summary: Tell the team
      value:
        type: script
        path: hub/28140/nextcloud/nextcloud_talk:_send_a_message
        input_transforms:
          nextcloud: { type: javascript, expr: flow_input.authentication.owner }
          token: { type: static, value: room-token-to-pick }
          message: { type: javascript, expr: "`New invoice: ${results.name} (${results.read.length} characters)`" }
files.f/ops/invoice_intake_nightly.schedule.ya:
path: f/ops/invoice_intake_nightly
script_path: f/ops/invoice_intake
is_flow: true
schedule: "30 0 7 * * 1-5"
timezone: Europe/Amsterdam
enabled: true
args:
  folder: /Invoices
files.f/ops/nextcloud.resource.yaml:
description: Nextcloud connection
resource_type: nextcloud
value:
  baseUrl: https://cloud.example.org
  userId: office
  token: qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq
files.f/ops/api_secret.variable.yaml:
description: A secret
is_secret: true
value: ''
files.f/ops/ticket_hook.http_trigger.yaml:
script_path: f/ops/ticket_hook
is_flow: true
route_path: tickets/new
http_method: post
request_type: async
authentication_method: api_key
files.f/ops/tickets.email_trigger.yaml:
script_path: f/ops/ticket_hook
is_flow: true
local_part: tickets
